interface: MAT ground assembly development geometry, version 1
coordinate_convention: x east, y north, z up, mm; ground FFL 0
authority: Preferred geometric development proposal derived from selected enclosure; the source HAD scene does not itself author a ground slab polygon. Coordinates are not structural, material, site or physical acceptance.

slab.scope: Gross conditional bounding footprint. Thresholds, openings, penetrations, cast splits, edge support, reinforcement, service boxes and as-built extents remain unassigned; not a construction takeoff.

SW_warm_pad.scope: Merged STR candidate at one location; union arithmetic only. Continuous reinforcement, pad/slab contact, floor build-up, field and all capacities remain open.

SW_cold_interface.scope: Merged STR development challenger, not site-foundation acceptance or a whole-house cold network. No insulation/bearing, tie, drainage or capacity is inferred.

threshold.status: Unassigned; the slab boundary does not define sill, frame, support or weather connection.

prior_comparators.historical_grid: The older -180..-630 lower-grid and -750 nodes are a separate conditional comparator, not the preferred present network.
prior_comparators.prior_first_floor_projection: The former 230×230 mm SW projection was a conditional first-floor proxy; this explicit core-face candidate contains the 300×300 pad, without retroactively authoring the HAD ground slab.

unassigned: All warm receivers beyond the single SW pad, including court-S and entrance nodes
Ground slab actual edge, structural reinforcement and all opening/penetration details
Whole-house cold routes, soil and site conditions
Thermal, DPC, capillary, water, gas and air continuity
Movement, construction, inspection, repair and all structural/material/site acceptance
